title: Small-scale LEO Satellite Networking for Global-scale Demands
authors: Yuanjie Li; Yimei Chen; Jiabo Yang; Jinyao Zhang; Bowen Sun; Lixin Liu; Hewu Li; Jianping Wu; Zeqi Lai; Qian Wu; Jun Liu
research_focus: Network topology, Routing / Load balancing, Capacity planning

problem_statement.en: Uniform orbital supply serves spatially uneven demand with excess satellites and complex control updates.
problem_statement.zh: 均勻 orbital supply 對應空間分布集中的 demand，造成衛星供給浪費與 control 更新成本。

key_innovation.en: Combine diverse Earth-repeat orbits; approximate supply-demand matching; preserve geographic intents using orbital MPC; enforce geographic SRv6 segment anycast.
key_innovation.zh: 組合多樣 Earth-repeat orbits，以近似演算法匹配 supply-demand，利用 orbital MPC 維持 geographic intent，再以 geographic SRv6 segment anycast 執行。

key_improvements.en: Strict demand matching gives 1,763/3,344/1,066 satellites versus 6,793 for customer/backbone/Latin-America demand; 99% availability gives 1,391/3,184/865. Planning takes 6.5–7.7h; control costs improve by 1–3 orders.
key_improvements.zh: 嚴格 demand matching 在 customer/backbone/Latin-America 需求採 1,763/3,344/1,066 顆，相對 reference 6,793 顆；99% availability 採 1,391/3,184/865 顆。planning 為 6.5–7.7h；control cost 改善 1–3 個數量級。

evidence: §3 equations 2–4; §4 MPC and anycast; §5 toolkit; §6.1–6.3, Fig.15; PDF pp.9–12

scope.en: The 7.9× headline corresponds to regional demand at 99% availability. Capacity and orbital synthesis assumptions determine feasibility; global access traffic differs from all-to-all cluster traffic.
scope.zh: 7.9× headline 對應 regional demand 與 99% availability。capacity 與 orbital synthesis 假設共同決定 feasibility；全球 access traffic 與 cluster all-to-all traffic 具有各自需求。

model.en: Integer-program constellation synthesis, greedy matching approximation, model predictive control and geographic reachability verification.
model.zh: integer-program 星座合成、greedy matching approximation、model predictive control 與 geographic reachability verification。

evaluation.en: 64,800 candidate tracks, 4,050 cells, three real-demand scenarios; 6,793-satellite Jan2025 reference; packet-level 1,741-container StarryNet-derived hardware-in-loop. Each modeled satellite offers 3×200Gbps ISL and 96Gbps radio access.
evaluation.zh: 64,800 candidate tracks、4,050 cells、三種 real-demand scenarios；2025 年 1 月 6,793 顆 reference；1,741-container 的 StarryNet 延伸 packet-level hardware-in-loop。模型每顆 satellite 配置 3×200Gbps ISL 與 96Gbps radio access。
